verdict.rationale: PostHog's data warehouse feature lets developers sync external sources (Stripe, Postgres, Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.) and query them in-product alongside events via SQL, while batch exports and a CDP with 50+ destinations support continuous export of events out to a warehouse or other systems. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of warehouse sync reliability at scale and no explicit mention of exporting to major warehouses like BigQuery/Snowflake/Redshift by name.
